experts.theory: P(v) = 1/100. Agar numbers sach me random hain to koi bhi model isse behtar nahi ho sakta.

experts.name: transforms
experts.label: Satta tricks (palti, cut, ±1, ±11 ...)
experts.theory: Har rule r = T(source) ke liye Beta posterior hit-rate q_r; weight ∝ exp(z_r). P = Σ w_r [q_r·δ(T(src)) + (1-q_r)/100].

experts.name: recency_h7
experts.label: Recency (half-life 7 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: cross_market
experts.label: Cross-market (kal ke doosre market)
experts.theory: P(andar | andar of M kal)·P(bahar | bahar of M kal), sab markets M ka average.

experts.name: recency_h30
experts.label: Recency (half-life 30 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: analog_k2
experts.label: Pattern match (pichle 2 din jaisa itihaas)
experts.theory: sim_j = Σ_l 2[y_(j-l)=y_(n-l)] + [andar same] + [bahar same]; P ∝ Σ_j exp(0.7·sim_j)·δ(y_j) (andar/bahar par).

experts.name: gap_hazard
experts.label: Gap / overdue hazard
experts.theory: Piecewise-constant hazard h(g) = events_g / exposure_g (Kaplan–Meier style). P(v) ∝ h(gap_v). Random game me h(g) har g par 1% hoga.

experts.name: spectral
experts.label: Fourier / spectral cycles
experts.theory: Har digit d ke liye indicator series b_t=[digit_t=d] ka periodogram; top-3 periods ka least-squares harmonic fit aur agle din tak extrapolation.

experts.name: recency_h90
experts.label: Recency (half-life 90 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: weekday
experts.label: Hafte ka din pattern
experts.theory: P(andar | weekday)·P(bahar | weekday), Laplace smoothing.

experts.name: markov_digit_x
experts.label: Markov digit (palti-cross)
experts.theory: P(andar_t | bahar_(t-1))·P(bahar_t | andar_(t-1))

experts.name: analog_k3
experts.label: Pattern match (pichle 3 din jaisa itihaas)
experts.theory: sim_j = Σ_l 2[y_(j-l)=y_(n-l)] + [andar same] + [bahar same]; P ∝ Σ_j exp(0.7·sim_j)·δ(y_j) (andar/bahar par).

experts.name: hot_digit_h20
experts.label: Hot Andar-Bahar (half-life 20)
experts.theory: P(v) = P(andar)·P(bahar), har digit ki decayed frequency se.

experts.name: formula_digit
experts.label: Khud ke formule (andar/bahar)
experts.theory: Andar aur Bahar ke liye alag (c1·u + c2·v + k) mod 10 formule, har 7 din par dobara search; top-3 ka vote, 60% uniform ke saath.

experts.name: hot_digit_h5
experts.label: Hot Andar-Bahar (half-life 5)
experts.theory: P(v) = P(andar)·P(bahar), har digit ki decayed frequency se.

experts.name: freq_a1
experts.label: Frequency (Bayes, alpha=1)
experts.theory: P(v) = (count(v) + a) / (n + 100a)  —  Dirichlet prior ke saath kitni baar aaya.

experts.name: markov_digit
experts.label: Markov chain (Andar→Andar, Bahar→Bahar)
experts.theory: P(andar_t | andar_(t-1))·P(bahar_t | bahar_(t-1)), Laplace smoothing.

experts.name: formula_jodi
experts.label: Khud ke formule (jodi)
experts.theory: Har 7 din par ~250 formule (c1·U + c2·V + k) mod 100 dobara dhoondhe jaate hain; top-5 vote karte hain: P = 0.75/100 + 0.25·Σ w_f δ(f).

experts.name: markov_jodi
experts.label: Markov chain (jodi→jodi)
experts.theory: P(v | pichla=x) = (C[x→v] + k·P_digit(v)) / (C[x] + k)  —  sparse hone par digit model par back-off.

theorems.title: Jodi uniformity (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: har jodi 00-99 ki probability barabar (1%) hai.
theorems.note: n<500: har jodi ka expected count 5 se kam, test kamzor hai.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Andar digit uniformity (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: Andar digit 0-9 sab barabar (10%) aate hain.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Bahar digit uniformity (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: Bahar digit 0-9 sab barabar (10%) aate hain.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Andar–Bahar independence (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: Andar digit aur Bahar digit ek doosre se independent hain.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Serial correlation (lag-1)
theorems.statement: H0: aaj ka number kal ke number se linearly related nahi hai (ρ=0).
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Runs test (Wald–Wolfowitz)
theorems.statement: H0: median se upar/neeche ka sequence random hai (na streaks, na zig-zag).
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Repeat (same jodi next draw)
theorems.statement: H0: agle draw me wahi jodi aane ka chance 1% hai.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Palti (ulta jodi next draw)
theorems.statement: H0: agle draw me palti jodi aane ka chance 1% hai.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Cross-market: Faridabad (kal) → andar
theorems.statement: H0: Faridabad ka kal ka andar digit, aaj ke andar digit ko affect nahi karta.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Cross-market: Ghaziabad (kal) → andar
theorems.statement: H0: Ghaziabad ka kal ka andar digit, aaj ke andar digit ko affect nahi karta.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Cross-market: Gali (kal) → andar
theorems.statement: H0: Gali ka kal ka andar digit, aaj ke andar digit ko affect nahi karta.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Entropy (Miller–Madow)
theorems.statement: Maximum possible randomness log2(100) = 6.644 bits. Jitna paas, utna unpredictable.
theorems.verdict: info

theorems.title: Hedge regret theorem (check on real data)
theorems.statement: Theorem: L_mix ≤ min_i L_i + ln N  (Bayes mixture, log-loss). Ensemble kabhi best model se ln N se zyada peeche nahi hoga.
theorems.verdict: Fixed-share alpha ki wajah se thoda upar (expected)
theorems.note: Agar L_mix ≈ random, to koi bhi model chance se behtar nahi hai.

experts.name: transforms
experts.label: Satta tricks (palti, cut, ±1, ±11 ...)
experts.theory: Har rule r = T(source) ke liye Beta posterior hit-rate q_r; weight ∝ exp(z_r). P = Σ w_r [q_r·δ(T(src)) + (1-q_r)/100].

experts.name: uniform
experts.label: Random baseline
experts.theory: P(v) = 1/100. Agar numbers sach me random hain to koi bhi model isse behtar nahi ho sakta.

experts.name: freq_a20
experts.label: Frequency (Bayes, alpha=20)
experts.theory: P(v) = (count(v) + a) / (n + 100a)  —  Dirichlet prior ke saath kitni baar aaya.

experts.name: recency_h7
experts.label: Recency (half-life 7 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: markov_digit
experts.label: Markov chain (Andar→Andar, Bahar→Bahar)
experts.theory: P(andar_t | andar_(t-1))·P(bahar_t | bahar_(t-1)), Laplace smoothing.

experts.name: analog_k2
experts.label: Pattern match (pichle 2 din jaisa itihaas)
experts.theory: sim_j = Σ_l 2[y_(j-l)=y_(n-l)] + [andar same] + [bahar same]; P ∝ Σ_j exp(0.7·sim_j)·δ(y_j) (andar/bahar par).

experts.name: hot_digit_h20
experts.label: Hot Andar-Bahar (half-life 20)
experts.theory: P(v) = P(andar)·P(bahar), har digit ki decayed frequency se.

experts.name: analog_k3
experts.label: Pattern match (pichle 3 din jaisa itihaas)
experts.theory: sim_j = Σ_l 2[y_(j-l)=y_(n-l)] + [andar same] + [bahar same]; P ∝ Σ_j exp(0.7·sim_j)·δ(y_j) (andar/bahar par).

experts.name: cross_market
experts.label: Cross-market (kal ke doosre market)
experts.theory: P(andar | andar of M kal)·P(bahar | bahar of M kal), sab markets M ka average.

experts.name: spectral
experts.label: Fourier / spectral cycles
experts.theory: Har digit d ke liye indicator series b_t=[digit_t=d] ka periodogram; top-3 periods ka least-squares harmonic fit aur agle din tak extrapolation.

experts.name: gap_hazard
experts.label: Gap / overdue hazard
experts.theory: Piecewise-constant hazard h(g) = events_g / exposure_g (Kaplan–Meier style). P(v) ∝ h(gap_v). Random game me h(g) har g par 1% hoga.

experts.name: hot_digit_h5
experts.label: Hot Andar-Bahar (half-life 5)
experts.theory: P(v) = P(andar)·P(bahar), har digit ki decayed frequency se.

experts.name: weekday
experts.label: Hafte ka din pattern
experts.theory: P(andar | weekday)·P(bahar | weekday), Laplace smoothing.

experts.name: recency_h30
experts.label: Recency (half-life 30 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: freq_a1
experts.label: Frequency (Bayes, alpha=1)
experts.theory: P(v) = (count(v) + a) / (n + 100a)  —  Dirichlet prior ke saath kitni baar aaya.

experts.name: recency_h90
experts.label: Recency (half-life 90 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: markov_jodi
experts.label: Markov chain (jodi→jodi)
experts.theory: P(v | pichla=x) = (C[x→v] + k·P_digit(v)) / (C[x] + k)  —  sparse hone par digit model par back-off.

experts.name: formula_jodi
experts.label: Khud ke formule (jodi)
experts.theory: Har 7 din par ~250 formule (c1·U + c2·V + k) mod 100 dobara dhoondhe jaate hain; top-5 vote karte hain: P = 0.75/100 + 0.25·Σ w_f δ(f).

experts.name: markov_digit_x
experts.label: Markov digit (palti-cross)
experts.theory: P(andar_t | bahar_(t-1))·P(bahar_t | andar_(t-1))

experts.name: formula_digit
experts.label: Khud ke formule (andar/bahar)
experts.theory: Andar aur Bahar ke liye alag (c1·u + c2·v + k) mod 10 formule, har 7 din par dobara search; top-3 ka vote, 60% uniform ke saath.

theorems.title: Jodi uniformity (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: har jodi 00-99 ki probability barabar (1%) hai.
theorems.note: n<500: har jodi ka expected count 5 se kam, test kamzor hai.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Andar digit uniformity (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: Andar digit 0-9 sab barabar (10%) aate hain.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Bahar digit uniformity (χ²)

theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Andar–Bahar independence (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: Andar digit aur Bahar digit ek doosre se independent hain.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Serial correlation (lag-1)
theorems.statement: H0: aaj ka number kal ke number se linearly related nahi hai (ρ=0).
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Runs test (Wald–Wolfowitz)
theorems.statement: H0: median se upar/neeche ka sequence random hai (na streaks, na zig-zag).
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Repeat (same jodi next draw)

theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Palti (ulta jodi next draw)
theorems.statement: H0: agle draw me palti jodi aane ka chance 1% hai.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.statement: H0: Disawar ka kal ka andar digit, aaj ke andar digit ko affect nahi karta.

theorems.title: Entropy (Miller–Madow)
theorems.statement: Maximum possible randomness log2(100) = 6.644 bits. Jitna paas, utna unpredictable.
theorems.verdict: info

theorems.title: Hedge regret theorem (check on real data)
theorems.statement: Theorem: L_mix ≤ min_i L_i + ln N  (Bayes mixture, log-loss). Ensemble kabhi best model se ln N se zyada peeche nahi hoga.
theorems.verdict: Fixed-share alpha ki wajah se thoda upar (expected)
theorems.note: Agar L_mix ≈ random, to koi bhi model chance se behtar nahi hai.

experts.name: uniform
experts.label: Random baseline
experts.theory: P(v) = 1/100. Agar numbers sach me random hain to koi bhi model isse behtar nahi ho sakta.

experts.name: transforms
experts.label: Satta tricks (palti, cut, ±1, ±11 ...)
experts.theory: Har rule r = T(source) ke liye Beta posterior hit-rate q_r; weight ∝ exp(z_r). P = Σ w_r [q_r·δ(T(src)) + (1-q_r)/100].

experts.name: freq_a20
experts.label: Frequency (Bayes, alpha=20)
experts.theory: P(v) = (count(v) + a) / (n + 100a)  —  Dirichlet prior ke saath kitni baar aaya.

experts.name: gap_hazard
experts.label: Gap / overdue hazard
experts.theory: Piecewise-constant hazard h(g) = events_g / exposure_g (Kaplan–Meier style). P(v) ∝ h(gap_v). Random game me h(g) har g par 1% hoga.

experts.name: formula_jodi
experts.label: Khud ke formule (jodi)
experts.theory: Har 7 din par ~250 formule (c1·U + c2·V + k) mod 100 dobara dhoondhe jaate hain; top-5 vote karte hain: P = 0.75/100 + 0.25·Σ w_f δ(f).

experts.name: recency_h7
experts.label: Recency (half-life 7 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: recency_h30
experts.label: Recency (half-life 30 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: recency_h90
experts.label: Recency (half-life 90 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: weekday
experts.label: Hafte ka din pattern
experts.theory: P(andar | weekday)·P(bahar | weekday), Laplace smoothing.

experts.name: cross_market
experts.label: Cross-market (kal ke doosre market)
experts.theory: P(andar | andar of M kal)·P(bahar | bahar of M kal), sab markets M ka average.

experts.name: analog_k2
experts.label: Pattern match (pichle 2 din jaisa itihaas)
experts.theory: sim_j = Σ_l 2[y_(j-l)=y_(n-l)] + [andar same] + [bahar same]; P ∝ Σ_j exp(0.7·sim_j)·δ(y_j) (andar/bahar par).

experts.name: freq_a1
experts.label: Frequency (Bayes, alpha=1)
experts.theory: P(v) = (count(v) + a) / (n + 100a)  —  Dirichlet prior ke saath kitni baar aaya.

experts.name: analog_k3
experts.label: Pattern match (pichle 3 din jaisa itihaas)
experts.theory: sim_j = Σ_l 2[y_(j-l)=y_(n-l)] + [andar same] + [bahar same]; P ∝ Σ_j exp(0.7·sim_j)·δ(y_j) (andar/bahar par).

experts.name: markov_digit_x
experts.label: Markov digit (palti-cross)
experts.theory: P(andar_t | bahar_(t-1))·P(bahar_t | andar_(t-1))

experts.name: hot_digit_h20
experts.label: Hot Andar-Bahar (half-life 20)
experts.theory: P(v) = P(andar)·P(bahar), har digit ki decayed frequency se.

experts.name: hot_digit_h5
experts.label: Hot Andar-Bahar (half-life 5)
experts.theory: P(v) = P(andar)·P(bahar), har digit ki decayed frequency se.

experts.name: markov_digit
experts.label: Markov chain (Andar→Andar, Bahar→Bahar)
experts.theory: P(andar_t | andar_(t-1))·P(bahar_t | bahar_(t-1)), Laplace smoothing.

experts.name: spectral
experts.label: Fourier / spectral cycles
experts.theory: Har digit d ke liye indicator series b_t=[digit_t=d] ka periodogram; top-3 periods ka least-squares harmonic fit aur agle din tak extrapolation.

experts.name: formula_digit
experts.label: Khud ke formule (andar/bahar)
experts.theory: Andar aur Bahar ke liye alag (c1·u + c2·v + k) mod 10 formule, har 7 din par dobara search; top-3 ka vote, 60% uniform ke saath.

experts.name: markov_jodi
experts.label: Markov chain (jodi→jodi)
experts.theory: P(v | pichla=x) = (C[x→v] + k·P_digit(v)) / (C[x] + k)  —  sparse hone par digit model par back-off.

theorems.statement: Maximum possible randomness log2(100) = 6.644 bits. Jitna paas, utna unpredictable.

theorems.title: Hedge regret theorem (check on real data)
theorems.statement: Theorem: L_mix ≤ min_i L_i + ln N  (Bayes mixture, log-loss). Ensemble kabhi best model se ln N se zyada peeche nahi hoga.
theorems.verdict: Fixed-share alpha ki wajah se thoda upar (expected)
theorems.note: Agar L_mix ≈ random, to koi bhi model chance se behtar nahi hai.

experts.name: uniform
experts.label: Random baseline
experts.theory: P(v) = 1/100. Agar numbers sach me random hain to koi bhi model isse behtar nahi ho sakta.

experts.name: freq_a20
experts.label: Frequency (Bayes, alpha=20)
experts.theory: P(v) = (count(v) + a) / (n + 100a)  —  Dirichlet prior ke saath kitni baar aaya.

experts.name: transforms
experts.label: Satta tricks (palti, cut, ±1, ±11 ...)
experts.theory: Har rule r = T(source) ke liye Beta posterior hit-rate q_r; weight ∝ exp(z_r). P = Σ w_r [q_r·δ(T(src)) + (1-q_r)/100].

experts.name: analog_k2
experts.label: Pattern match (pichle 2 din jaisa itihaas)
experts.theory: sim_j = Σ_l 2[y_(j-l)=y_(n-l)] + [andar same] + [bahar same]; P ∝ Σ_j exp(0.7·sim_j)·δ(y_j) (andar/bahar par).

experts.name: spectral
experts.label: Fourier / spectral cycles
experts.theory: Har digit d ke liye indicator series b_t=[digit_t=d] ka periodogram; top-3 periods ka least-squares harmonic fit aur agle din tak extrapolation.

experts.name: analog_k3
experts.label: Pattern match (pichle 3 din jaisa itihaas)
experts.theory: sim_j = Σ_l 2[y_(j-l)=y_(n-l)] + [andar same] + [bahar same]; P ∝ Σ_j exp(0.7·sim_j)·δ(y_j) (andar/bahar par).

experts.name: cross_market
experts.label: Cross-market (kal ke doosre market)
experts.theory: P(andar | andar of M kal)·P(bahar | bahar of M kal), sab markets M ka average.

experts.name: markov_digit_x
experts.label: Markov digit (palti-cross)
experts.theory: P(andar_t | bahar_(t-1))·P(bahar_t | andar_(t-1))

experts.name: hot_digit_h5
experts.label: Hot Andar-Bahar (half-life 5)
experts.theory: P(v) = P(andar)·P(bahar), har digit ki decayed frequency se.

experts.name: hot_digit_h20
experts.label: Hot Andar-Bahar (half-life 20)
experts.theory: P(v) = P(andar)·P(bahar), har digit ki decayed frequency se.

experts.name: weekday
experts.label: Hafte ka din pattern
experts.theory: P(andar | weekday)·P(bahar | weekday), Laplace smoothing.

experts.name: markov_digit
experts.label: Markov chain (Andar→Andar, Bahar→Bahar)
experts.theory: P(andar_t | andar_(t-1))·P(bahar_t | bahar_(t-1)), Laplace smoothing.

experts.name: freq_a1
experts.label: Frequency (Bayes, alpha=1)
experts.theory: P(v) = (count(v) + a) / (n + 100a)  —  Dirichlet prior ke saath kitni baar aaya.

experts.name: gap_hazard
experts.label: Gap / overdue hazard
experts.theory: Piecewise-constant hazard h(g) = events_g / exposure_g (Kaplan–Meier style). P(v) ∝ h(gap_v). Random game me h(g) har g par 1% hoga.

experts.name: recency_h7
experts.label: Recency (half-life 7 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: recency_h90
experts.label: Recency (half-life 90 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: recency_h30
experts.label: Recency (half-life 30 din)
experts.theory: P(v) ∝ Σ 2^(-age/h)·[y=v] + 0.5  —  naye results ka wazan zyada.

experts.name: formula_digit
experts.label: Khud ke formule (andar/bahar)
experts.theory: Andar aur Bahar ke liye alag (c1·u + c2·v + k) mod 10 formule, har 7 din par dobara search; top-3 ka vote, 60% uniform ke saath.

experts.name: formula_jodi
experts.label: Khud ke formule (jodi)
experts.theory: Har 7 din par ~250 formule (c1·U + c2·V + k) mod 100 dobara dhoondhe jaate hain; top-5 vote karte hain: P = 0.75/100 + 0.25·Σ w_f δ(f).

experts.name: markov_jodi
experts.label: Markov chain (jodi→jodi)
experts.theory: P(v | pichla=x) = (C[x→v] + k·P_digit(v)) / (C[x] + k)  —  sparse hone par digit model par back-off.

theorems.title: Jodi uniformity (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: har jodi 00-99 ki probability barabar (1%) hai.
theorems.note: n<500: har jodi ka expected count 5 se kam, test kamzor hai.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Andar digit uniformity (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: Andar digit 0-9 sab barabar (10%) aate hain.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Bahar digit uniformity (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: Bahar digit 0-9 sab barabar (10%) aate hain.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Andar–Bahar independence (χ²)
theorems.statement: H0: Andar digit aur Bahar digit ek doosre se independent hain.
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Serial correlation (lag-1)
theorems.statement: H0: aaj ka number kal ke number se linearly related nahi hai (ρ=0).
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Runs test (Wald–Wolfowitz)
theorems.statement: H0: median se upar/neeche ka sequence random hai (na streaks, na zig-zag).
theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Repeat (same jodi next draw)

theorems.verdict: Random jaisa — pattern sabit nahi hua

theorems.title: Palti (ulta jodi next draw)

theorems.title: Entropy (Miller–Madow)
theorems.statement: Maximum possible randomness log2(100) = 6.644 bits. Jitna paas, utna unpredictable.
theorems.verdict: info

theorems.title: Hedge regret theorem (check on real data)
theorems.statement: Theorem: L_mix ≤ min_i L_i + ln N  (Bayes mixture, log-loss). Ensemble kabhi best model se ln N se zyada peeche nahi hoga.
theorems.verdict: Fixed-share alpha ki wajah se thoda upar (expected)
theorems.note: Agar L_mix ≈ random, to koi bhi model chance se behtar nahi hai.
